items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: We heard old Joe Turner at the Hawaiian Gardens

ctx.x: Right, you're still back in college?

Yeah. So we'd have our little jam sessions in there, and go over to Missouri. We heard old Joe Turner at the Hawaiian Gardens, and we'd go down to the Sunset Club, which was on 12th and Woodland. And that was really something about 10 feet wide, maybe 12 feet wide, maybe 60 feet long.
(chuckle) It was a twit (phonetic) long? sixty feet?
